doc: Authoritative set of wire close codes for the voice-ws-v1 adapter, extracted from src/voice/websocket_server.py.

close_codes.name: MESSAGE_TOO_BIG
close_codes.meaning: standard websockets frame too large (over max_size)

close_codes.name: PROTOCOL_CLOSE_INVALID
close_codes.meaning: invalid protocol / VOICE_PROTOCOL_INVALID (bad field, JSON, type, sequence, size)
